objective_for_doctor:
Age: 17
Sex: F
Chief Complaint: loss of consciousness

turns.content: Hello, I'm your doctor today. What brings you in today?

I’ve lost consciousness. I’m also coughing up blood, and I have significant shortness of breath or difficulty breathing. I have sharp pain rated 4/10 that’s on both sides of my chest and the posterior chest wall, and it involves my scapula areas too.
When did you first lose consciousness, and how long did the episode last?
I don’t know.
Do you have any recent history of trauma to your chest or back, such as a fall, car accident, or heavy lifting?
I don’t know.
Are you currently taking any blood‑thinning medications (e.g., warfarin, apixaban, clopidogrel) or have you recently started a new medication?
Yes—I currently take hormones. I don’t know about any blood‑thinning medications.
Have you noticed any fever, chills, or recent upper‑respiratory symptoms (cough, sore throat, congestion) before the coughing up blood began?
I don’t know.
Is the chest pain worse when you breathe in deeply or cough, and does it radiate to your neck, jaw, or arm on either side?
I don’t know.
Are you a current or former smoker? If so, how many pack‑years have you smoked?
I don’t know.
Do you have any swelling, pain, or redness in your legs—especially in the calves—or have you noticed any recent leg discomfort?
Yes—there is swelling in the posterior aspect of my ankle (right).
When did the shortness of breath and coughing up blood start, and have they been getting progressively worse?
I don’t know.
Do you have any recent history of prolonged immobility (e.g., long car or airplane trips, bed rest after illness or surgery) in the past two weeks?
Yes. I’ve been unable to move or get up for more than 3 consecutive days within the last 4 weeks. I also traveled out of the country to North America in the last 4 weeks.
